title: Hilton Strengthens Bengaluru Portfolio with Signing of Conrad Bengaluru Airport and Hilton Bengaluru Airport, Adding 600 Rooms
summary: Hilton today announced the signing of two hotels in Bengaluru under Conrad Hotels & Resorts and Hilton Hotels & Resorts.

Listen to this article


0:00


- **Agreement marks the signing of two hotels in Bengaluru under Conrad Hotels & Resorts and Hilton Hotels & Resorts, with a combined room count of 600** .
- **Strategic expansion brings second Conrad and fourth Hilton hotel to Bengaluru, India’s Silicon Valley** .
- **Signing strengthens Hilton's leadership in Bengaluru and deepens its longstanding partnership with Kalyani Group** .


**BENGALURU, India –**[Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/) (NYSE: HLT) today announced the signing of two hotels under its[Conrad Hotels & Resorts](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/conrad-hotels/?msockid=2387114ed6566c08320d0434d7116d14) and[Hilton Hotels & Resorts](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/hilton-hotels/) brands, in partnership with Bengaluru-based Kalyani Group. The cluster development, featuring a combined 600 rooms, further expands Hilton’s presence in its largest market in India by number of hotels and marks a repeat signing with Kalyani Group following the successful opening of[DoubleTree by Hilton Bengaluru Whitefield](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/blrkudi-doubletree-bengaluru-whitefield/) in 2024.


Image (L-R) – Anthony Huang, senior general manager, Hospitality, Kalyani Developers; Jacob Purackal, VP, Development, South Asia Hilton; Alan Watts, president, Asia Pacific, Hilton; Priyanka M Raju, director, Kalyani Developers; Katherine Lugar, EVP, Corporate Affairs, Hilton; Mrs. Roopa Raju, director, Kalyani Developers; Laura Fuentes, EVP, chief human resources officer, Hilton Supply Management; Zubin Saxena, SVP & regional head, South Asia, Hilton; Rohan M Raju, director, Kalyani Developers


Conrad Hotels & Resorts brings a contemporary approach to luxury through purposeful design, curated art and thoughtful experiences that invite guests to engage with a destination on their own terms. The brand currently welcomes guests in Bengaluru and Pune, with Conrad Jaipur also under development, and Conrad Bengaluru Airport will further build its presence in one of India’s most dynamic destinations.


Hilton Hotels & Resorts bring global sophistication together with local culture and genuine hospitality, offering energizing spaces, destination dining and memorable meetings and events that inspire connection and discovery, making the brand well suited to both business and leisure travelers. There are eight Hilton properties in India including in Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Gurugram, Jaipur and Goa, with another 11 under development across the country.


Conrad Bengaluru Airport and Hilton Bengaluru Airport will each feature 300 guest rooms, a range of dining venues, meeting and event spaces, wellness facilities and other amenities. The hotels will form a cluster complex located in KIADB Hi-Tech Defence and Aerospace Park, which is emerging as a major domestic and international hub for commercial, technology, aerospace and business activity as the Indian aviation sector grows rapidly.


With over 72,000 square feet of event space, this substantial MICE offering positions the complex to capitalize on increasing demand for large-scale conferences, corporate gatherings and social events, making it a premier hospitality destination in one of India's most dynamic and fast-growing markets. The hotels are expected to open in 2030 and will be approximately 20 minutes away from Kempegowda International Airport, positioning them to serve demand from both business and leisure travelers.


Alan Watts, president, Asia Pacific, Hilton, said, "This landmark signing represents a significant milestone in strengthening Hilton's presence in Bengaluru and reflects our long-term confidence in the market. As we advance our ambition to exceed 400 hotels in India over the next decade, Bengaluru will remain a key focus for expansion. Together with Kalyani Group, we look forward to bringing another world-class hospitality destination to the city that will serve the evolving needs of travelers and contribute to Bengaluru's continued growth as a global business and leisure hub."


Mr. Mohan Raju, managing director, Kalyani Developers, said, “Our continued partnership with Hilton reflects the strength of its brands and the confidence we have in its long-term vision for Bengaluru. Following the success of DoubleTree by Hilton Bengaluru Whitefield, this signing marks a natural next step in expanding our hospitality presence in the city. We are pleased to bring Conrad Bengaluru Airport and Hilton Bengaluru Airport to support the city’s growing demand for high-quality hospitality offerings, while contributing to its continued evolution as one of India’s most dynamic business and travel destinations.”


Priyanka M Raju and Rohan M Raju, Directors, Kalyani Developers, said, “This project represents an important milestone for us as we look to build on our family’s longstanding commitment to elevating Bengaluru’s hospitality landscape and creating destinations that contribute meaningfully to the city’s growth and development. Together with Hilton, we look forward to bringing this vision to life by creating a distinctive hospitality offering that combines the best of a world-class full-service brand and a luxury brand under one destination.


Conrad Hotels & Resorts and Hilton Hotels & Resorts participate in Hilton Honors, the award-winning guest loyalty program for Hilton’s 28 distinct hotel brands. Hilton Honors members who book directly through preferred Hilton channels have access to instant benefits, including flexible Points and money payment options, exclusive member discounts and complimentary standard Wi-Fi. Members also enjoy popular digital tools available exclusively through the Hilton Honors mobile app, including digital check-in, room selection and Digital Key.


##### FAQ: Hilton Strengthens Bengaluru Portfolio with Signing of Conrad Bengaluru Airport and Hilton Bengaluru Airport, Adding 600 Rooms


Two new hotels, Conrad Bengaluru Airport and Hilton Bengaluru Airport are coming to Bengaluru, adding 600 rooms.


The hotels will be located at KIADB Hi-Tech Defence and Aerospace Park, around 20 minutes from Kempegowda International Airport.


Both hotels are expected to open in 2030.


The hotels are being developed by Kalyani Group in partnership with Hilton, marking a continuation of their relationship following the successful opening of DoubleTree by Hilton Bengaluru Whitefield in 2024.


The development will feature 300 rooms at Conrad Hotels & Resorts and 300 rooms at Hilton Hotels & Resorts, for a total of 600 rooms.
